name: PNCA Pre-College summer art and design programs
org: Pacific Northwest College of Art (PNCA) at Willamette University, Community Education
what_you_do: 2 week Intensives and 1 week Studios. You draw, paint, animate and illustrate with PNCA teachers and artists. You build portfolio work. You meet admissions staff for a portfolio review.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 18 who have finished at least one year of high school.
pay_detail: Tuition (includes materials) for Summer 2027 will be announced when applications open this fall. Need-based scholarships and payment plans are available; early registration saves 10%.
duration: Intensives are 2 weeks and Studios are 1 week, 9 am to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday. 2027 sessions run July 12 to Aug 6.
deadline_text: Applications open fall 2026. 2027 dates: early application Mar 28, early registration Apr 11, application deadline May 2, registration deadline June 6 (rolling until full).
how_to_apply: Apply online on a rolling basis until programs are full. Applications open fall 2026, per the page.
notes: The page does not list dollar amounts for tuition or scholarships.
